main.description: Fetch the full vertex_vessel master row for a given MMSI plus the most recent track (default 24h, hard cap 500 points) and the active vessel_voyage row if any. ADR-2605011500.

trackHours.description: Hours of track history to return (default 24, max 168).

vessel.description: { mmsi, imo?, callsign?, name?, type_code?, type_class, flag_mid?, flag_iso?, length_m?, width_m?, draught_m?, source, first_seen_ms, last_seen_ms }. null if MMSI unknown.

recentTrack.description: Array of { ts_ms, lat, lon, sog_knot?, cog_deg?, heading_deg?, nav_status? } sorted by ts_ms ascending.

voyage.description: Latest vertex_vessel_voyage row: { departure_port_locode?, departure_ms?, arrival_port_locode?, arrival_ms?, declared_eta_ms?, declared_destination?, declared_draught_m? }. null if no voyage detected.

owners.description: Array of legal-entity owner edges, most recent first: { lei, name?, country?, entity_type?, legal_entity_vid?, share_pct?, source, effective_from_ms? }. Empty when no edge_vessel_owned_by row matches the MMSI (Wikidata enrichment task seeds these).

operators.description: Array of legal-entity operator/manager edges, most recent first: { lei, name?, country?, entity_type?, legal_entity_vid?, role?, source, effective_from_ms? }. Empty when no edge_vessel_operated_by row matches the MMSI.
